title: Mushroom Tacos
description: These tacos are the best ever! You can use beef or venison. The mushroom trick helps cut back on meat and makes the recipe a much healthier and tasty option.
ingredients: 1 (8 ounce) package mushrooms, finely chopped or pulsed in a food processor
1 package taco seasoning, or to taste
2 tablespoons lime juice, or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 (8 ounce) jar salsa, or as desired
0.25 cup crumbled blue cheese, or to taste

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a saute pan over medium-high heat. Add onions and cook about 3 minutes. Add garlic and cook 2 minutes more. Add venison and mushrooms; saute until venison is cooked through, 5 to 7 minutes more. Season with taco seasoning.
Toss cabbage, lime juice, cilantro, salt, and pepper together in a bowl.
Place about 2 tablespoons cabbage mixture onto a tortilla and top with about 2 tablespoons meat mixture. Top with salsa and blue cheese. Repeat with remaining fillings, tortillas, and toppings.
